title: SAP Business One Web Client UI API Controls Schema
description: A schema to define the control definitions for Web Client UI API.

enabled.description: determine whether the control is enabled

additionalText.description: additional text to be displayed along with this item

b1.sdk.Button.title: UI Control: Button
b1.sdk.Button.description: A button control that enables users to trigger actions.

enabled.description: Determine whether the control is enabled.

tooltip.description: Tooltip text when user hover on this control.

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible.

press.description: Fired when the user clicks or taps on the button control.

b1.sdk.CheckBox.title: UI Control: CheckBox
b1.sdk.CheckBox.description: CheckBox control allows users to set a boolean value, such as true/false or yes/no for an item

selected.description: determine whether the control is selected

tooltip.description: tooltip text when user hover on this control

editable.description: determine whether the control is editable

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

select.description: Fired when check box is selected/unselected

b1.sdk.Input.title: UI Control: Input
b1.sdk.Input.description: Input control allows users to enter and edit text or numeric values in one line.

editable.description: Determine whether the control is editable

enabled.description: Determine whether the control is enabled

mandatory.description: Whether display a red asterisk before label text

tooltip.description: Tooltip text when user hover on this control

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters for input value

wrapping.description: Whether break a new line if not editable

valueStateText.description: An additional text show around for valueState

showSuggestion.description: Whether to show suggestion when user inputs

suggestionItems.description: Items displayed in the suggestion popup(see `b1.sdk.Item`).

currency.description: The currency part ($, EUR) of a Currency (Sum,Tax,Price) Input. The currency value will be validated and can not be empty when input bind the currency property

change.description: Fired when value changed in the input control.

suggest.description: Fired when user input and "showSuggestion" is true.

b1.sdk.ComboBox.title: UI Control: ComboBox
b1.sdk.ComboBox.description: ComboBox control is a drop-down list for selecting and filtering values. The control represents a drop-down menu with a list of the available options and a text input field to narrow down the options.

editable.description: determine whether the control is editable

tooltip.description: tooltip text when hovering on this control

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

change.description: Fired when one of the ComboBox Item is selected

b1.sdk.StaticText.title: UI Control: StaticText
b1.sdk.StaticText.description: StaticText control is used for embedding longer text paragraphs that need text wrapping into your app.

text.description: determines the text to be displayed

maxLines.description: limits the number of lines for wrapping texts

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

tooltip.description: tooltip text when user hover on this control

b1.sdk.Group.title: UI Control: Group
b1.sdk.Group.description: Group arranges labels and fields (like input fields) into groups and rows.

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

align.description: show group on right side if assign value right

width.description: default display two group each line, if you want use entire line for one group, set to 12

b1.sdk.SubSection.title: UI Control Aggregate: SubSection
b1.sdk.SubSection.description: Subsection is a second-level information container, which is generally used in an object page layout.

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible.

b1.sdk.Section.title: UI Control: Section
b1.sdk.Section.description: Section is a top-level information container, which is generally used in an object page layout and is for the purpose of aggregating subsections containing second-level information.

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

showTitle.description: determine whether the text is visible

b1.sdk.Column.title: UI Control Aggregate: Column
b1.sdk.Column.description: Column allows users to define column specific properties that will be applied when rendering the table.

guid.description: Global unique identifier. All the grid columns will add 'COLUMN_' as prefix, and for all the template in column will add 'CELL_' as prefix automatically.

text.description: Label of the column which is displayed in the column header.

tooltip.description: The tooltip that should be shown for this Element.

width.description: Width of the column in CSS units.

minWidth.description: Defines the minimum width of a column in pixels.

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible.

useDefaultSort.description: If set to false, developer need to implement the sorting logic in grid sort event.

sortProperty.description: Specifies the binding property on which the column will sort. Since the column template may have composite bindings, it's not possible to figure out on which binding property the sort shall be applied. Therefore the binding property for sorting must be specified. For example, if the first name and last name are displayed in the same column, only one of the two can be defined as sortProperty.

filtered.description: Indicates if the column is filtered.

filterProperty.description: Specifies the binding property on which the column shall be filtered.

hAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the column content. Controls with a text align do not inherit the horizontal alignment. You have to set the text align directly on the template.

b1.sdk.Grid.title: UI Control: Grid
b1.sdk.Grid.description: Grid control provides a comprehensive set of features for displaying and dealing with vast amounts of data.

anyOf.description: ui5 data binding expression including a customized data model distinct with "@@". For example, "{@@demo>/rows}".

visibleRowCount.description: number of visible rows of the grid

visible.description: whether the control should be visible on the screen

columnHeaderVisible.description: flag whether the column header is visible or not

enableSelectAll.description: specifies if a select all button should be displayed in the top left corner. This button is only displayed if the row selector is visible and the selection mode is set to any kind of multi selection

selectionBehavior.description: selection behavior of the table. This property defines whether the row selector is displayed and whether the row, the row selector or both can be clicked to select a row

showNoData.description: flag whether to show the no data overlay or not once the table is empty. If set to false the table will just show a grid of empty cells

noData.description: the text in table in case of no data

busy.description: whether the control is currently in busy state

itemPressed.description: Fired when the cell of row is pressed

rowSelectionChange.description: Fired when the row selection of the gird has been changed.

firstVisibleRowChanged.description: Fired when the first visible row is changed.

filter.description: Fired when the grid is filtered.

sort.description: Fired when the grid is sorted.

paste.description: Fired when the user pastes content from the clipboard to the table.

b1.sdk.HBox.title: UI Control: HBox
b1.sdk.HBox.description: The HBox control builds the container for a horizontal flexible box layout.

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

mandatory.description: Whether display a red asterisk before label text

width.description: The width of the flexible box

direction.description: Determines the direction of the layout of child elements

justifyContent.description: Determines the layout behavior along the main axis

alignItems.description: Determines the layout behavior of items along the cross-axis

items.description: Flex items within the flexible box layout

b1.sdk.MessageStrip.title: UI Control: MessageStrip
b1.sdk.MessageStrip.description: MessageStrip control enables the embedding of application-related messages in the application

customIcon.description: Represent an RFC3986 conformant URI starting with 'sap-icon://'

showCloseButton.description: determine if the message has a close button in the upper right corner

showIcon.description: determine if an icon is displayed for the message

text.description: determines the text of the message

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

close.description: Fired when the user clicks the close button.

b1.sdk.DatePicker.title: UI Control: DatePicker
b1.sdk.DatePicker.description: DatePicker control lets the users select a localized date using touch, mouse, or keyboard input

mandatory.description: whether display a red asterisk before label text

displayFormat.description: determines the format, displayed in the input field, by default the medium format of the used locale is used

valueFormat.description: determines the format of the value property

placeholder.description: defines a short hint intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value, if no placeholder is set, the used displayFormat is displayed as a placeholder

editable.description: determines whether the control is editable

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

valueStateText.description: An additional text show around for valueState

maxDate.description: maximum date that can be shown and selected in the DatePicker

minDate.description: minimum date that can be shown and selected in the DatePicker

showCurrentDateButton.description: determine whether there is a shortcut navigation to Today

showFooter.description: hides or shows the popover's footer

b1.sdk.TimePicker.title: UI Control: TimePicker
b1.sdk.TimePicker.description: TimePicker control enables the users to fill time related input fields using touch, mouse, or keyboard input

mandatory.description: whether display a red asterisk before label text

displayFormat.description: determines the format, displayed in the input field

valueFormat.description: determines the format of the value property

placeholder.description: defines a short hint intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value

editable.description: determines whether the control is editable

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

valueStateText.description: An additional text show around for valueState

showCurrentTimeButton.description: determine whether there is a shortcut navigation to current time

b1.sdk.ObjectStatus.title: UI Control: ObjectStatus
b1.sdk.ObjectStatus.description: ObjectStatus control displays status information that can be either text with a value state, or an icon.

active.description: indicates if the ObjectStatus text and icon can be clicked/tapped by the user

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

tooltip.description: Tooltip text when user hover on this control.

inverted.description: determines whether the background color reflects the set state instead of the control's text

press.description: Fired when the user clicks or taps on the control.

b1.sdk.MenuItem.title: UI Control Aggregate: MenuItem
b1.sdk.MenuItem.description: A MenuItem is a control to create items for the MenuButton.

key.description: Can be used as input for subsequent actions.

text.description: The text to be displayed for the item.

enabled.description: determine whether the control is enabled

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

startsSection.description: Defines whether a visual separator should be rendered before the item.

textDirection.description: Available options for the text direction.

press.description: Fired after the item has been pressed.

b1.sdk.MenuButton.title: UI Control: MenuButton
b1.sdk.MenuButton.description: MenuButton control enables the user to show a hierarchical menu.

text.description: Defines the text of the MenuButton

enabled.description: determine whether the control is enabled

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

type.description: Defines the type of the MenuButton

tooltip.description: Tooltip text when user hover on this control.

buttonMode.description: Defines whether the MenuButton is set to Regular or Split mode.

useDefaultActionOnly.description: Controls whether the default action handler is invoked always or it is invoked only until a menu item is selected. Usable only if buttonMode is set to Split.

menuPosition.description: Specifies the position of the popup menu with enumerated options.

textDirection.description: Specifies the element's text directionality with enumerated options.

width.description: Width of the MenuButton in CSS units.

items.description: Defines the menu that opens for this button.

itemSelected.description: Fired when the menu item is selected.

loadItems.description: Fired when menu item is clicked and the data used to display items is not already loaded.

defaultAction.description: Fired when the buttonMode is set to Split and the user presses the main button unless useDefaultActionOnly is set to false and another action from the menu has been selected previously.

b1.sdk.Image.title: UI Control: Image
b1.sdk.Image.description: Image control displays image loaded from a remote or local server.

tooltip.description: tooltip text when user hover on this control

src.description: relative or absolute path to URL where the image file is stored

alt.description: the alternative text that is displayed in case the image is not available, or cannot be displayed

lazyLoading.description: enables lazy loading for images that are offscreen

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

load.description: Fired when the image resource is loaded.

press.description: Fired when the user clicks on the control.

b1.sdk.LightBoxItem.title: UI Control Aggregate: LightBoxItem
b1.sdk.LightBoxItem.description: LightBoxItem control represents an item which is displayed within a LightBox.

b1.sdk.TextArea.title: UI Control: TextArea
b1.sdk.TextArea.description: TextArea control is used to enter multiple lines of text.

tooltip.description: tooltip text when user hover on this control

editable.description: determine whether the control is editable

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

mandatory.description: Whether display a red asterisk before label text

textDirection.description: Defines the text directionality of the input field.

rows.description: Defines the number of visible text lines for the control.

cols.description: Defines the visible width of the control, in average character widths.

maxLength.description: Defines the maximum number of characters that the value can be.

value.description: Defines the value of the control.

valueState.description: Visualizes the validation state of the control.

valueStateText.description: Defines the text that appears in the value state message pop-up.

growing.description: Indicates the ability of the control to automatically grow and shrink dynamically with its content

growingMaxLines.description: Defines the maximum number of lines that the control can grow

height.description: Defines the height of the control in CSS units

width.description: Defines the width of the control in CSS units

showExceededText.description: Determines whether the characters, exceeding the maximum allowed character count, are visible in the input field.

valueLiveUpdate.description: Indicates when the value property gets updated with the user changes

wrapping.description: Indicates how the control wraps the text.

change.description: Fired when value changed in the control.

b1.sdk.RadioButton.title: UI Control: RadioButton
b1.sdk.RadioButton.description: RadioButton is a control similar to a checkbox, but it allows you to choose only one of the predefined set of options. Multiple radio buttons have to belong to the same group (have the same value for groupName) in order to be mutually exclusive.

text.description: Specifies the text displayed next to the radio button

selected.description: Specifies the select state of the radio button

enabled.description: Specifies if the radio button is disabled

editable.description: Specifies whether the user can select the radio button.

visible.description: Specifies whether the user can see the radio button

key.description: Indicates a unique key for radio button

groupName.description: Name of the radio button group the current radio button belongs to.

useEntireWidth.description: Indicates if the given width will be applied for the whole RadioButton or only it's label. By Default width is set only for the label

valueState.description: Marker for the correctness of the current value e.g., Error, Success, etc.

width.description: Width of the RadioButton or it's label depending on the useEntireWidth property. By Default width is set only for the label.

tooltip.description: tooltip text when user hover on this control

select.description: Event is triggered when the user makes a change on the radio button (selecting or unselecting it).

b1.sdk.RadioButtonGroup.title: UI Control: RadioButtonGroup
b1.sdk.RadioButtonGroup.description: radio button group used as a wrapper for a group of b1.sdk.RadioButton controls, which can be used as a single UI element. You can select only one of the grouped radio buttons at a time.

enabled.description: Switches the enabled state of the control. All RadioButtons inside a disabled group are disabled.

editable.description: Specifies whether the user can change the selected value of the RadioButtonGroup.

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

selectedIndex.description: Determines the index of the selected/checked RadioButton.

width.description: Specifies the width of the RadioButtonGroup.

columns.description: Specifies the maximum number of radio buttons displayed in one line.

select.description: Fires when selection is changed by user interaction.

items.description: Aggregation of items to be displayed (see `b1.sdk.RadioButton`).

b1.sdk.ObjectNumber.title: UI Control: ObjectNumber
b1.sdk.ObjectNumber.description: The ObjectNumber control displays number and number unit properties for an object. The number can be displayed using semantic colors to provide additional meaning about the object to the user.

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

state.description: determines the object number's value state

textDirection.description: available options for the number and unit text direction

textAlign.description: Sets the horizontal alignment of the number and unit

active.description: Indicates if the ObjectNumber text and icon can be clicked/tapped by the user

inverted.description: Determines whether the background color reflects the set state instead of the control's text

emptyIndicatorMode.description: Specifies if an empty indicator should be displayed when there is no number.

emphasized.description: Indicates if the object number should appear emphasized.

b1.sdk.ProgressIndicator.title: UI Control: ProgressIndicator
b1.sdk.ProgressIndicator.description: The ProgressIndicator control shows the progress of a process in a graphical way.

tooltip.description: tooltip text when user hover on this control

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

state.description: specifies the state of the bar

percentValue.description: specifies the numerical value in percent for the length of the progress bar

displayValue.description: specifies the text value to be displayed in the bar

showValue.description: indicates whether the displayValue should be shown in the ProgressIndicator

enabled.description: determine whether the control is enabled

displayAnimation.description: determines whether a percentage change is displayed with animation

displayOnly.description: determines whether the control is in display-only state where the control has different visualization and cannot be focused

height.description: specifies the height of the control in CSS units

textDirection.description: Specifies the element's text directionality with enumerated options

width.description: specifies the width of the control in CSS units

b1.sdk.SegmentedButton.title: UI Control: SegmentedButton
b1.sdk.SegmentedButton.description: A horizontal control made of multiple buttons, which can display a title or an image.

mandatory.description: whether display a red asterisk before label text

enabled.description: determine whether the control is enabled

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

tooltip.description: tooltip text when user hover on this control

items.description: Aggregation of items to be displayed (see `b1.sdk.SegmentedButtonItem`).

selectionChange.description: Fires when the user selects an item, which returns the item object.

b1.sdk.SegmentedButtonItem.title: UI Control Aggregate: SegmentedButtonItem
b1.sdk.SegmentedButtonItem.description: Used for creating buttons for the SegmentedButton.

enabled.description: determine whether the control is enabled

visible.description: determine whether the control is visible

press.description: Fires when the user clicks on an individual button.

b1.sdk.FormContainer.title: UI Control Aggregate: FormContainer
b1.sdk.FormContainer.description: A FormContainer represents a group inside a Form. The rendering of the FormContainer is done by the gridLayoutData assigned to the Form.

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible

b1.sdk.Form.title: UI Control: Form
b1.sdk.Form.description: A Form control arranges labels and fields (like input fields) into groups and rows.

leftLabel.description: Determine whether labels inside the Form is left aligned.

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible

gridLayoutData.description: The form responsive grid layout data.

columnsM.description: Number of columns for medium size.

columnsL.description: Number of columns for large size.

columnsXL.description: Number of columns for extra large size.

labelSpanXL.description: Default span for labels in extra large size.

emptySpanL.description: Number of grid cells that are empty at the end of each line on large size.

emptySpanXL.description: Number of grid cells that are empty at the end of each line on extra large size.

labelSpanM.description: Default span for labels in medium size.

formContainers.description: Containers with the content of the form. A FormContainer represents a group inside the Form.

b1.sdk.FileUploader.title: UI Control: FileUploader
b1.sdk.FileUploader.description: FileUploader control allows users to upload files from their local file system.

tooltip.description: tooltip text when user hover on this control

additionalData.description: additional data to be sent to the back end service

buttonOnly.description: determines if the FileUploader is rendered as Button only

buttonText.description: defines the text shown for the button

icon.description: icon to be displayed as graphical element within the button

directory.description: allows users to upload all files from a given directory and its corresponding subdirectories

uploadUrl.description: URL where the uploaded files should be sent to

name.description: unique control name for identification on the server side after sending data to the server

value.description: value of the path for file upload

width.description: width of the control in CSS units

style.description: style of the button, values "Transparent", "Accept", "Reject", or "Emphasized" are allowed.

uploadOnChange.description: determines if upload immediately starts after file selection

sendXHR.description: determines whether the request will be sent as XHR request instead of a form submit

enabled.description: determines whether the control is enabled

multiple.description: allows multiple files to be chosen and uploaded from the same folder

editable.description: determine whether the control is editable, it's visible when editable

valueStateText.description: An additional text show around for valueState

b1.sdk.ChooseFromList.title: UI Control: ChooseFromList
b1.sdk.ChooseFromList.description: ChooseFromList control that allows users to select items from a table defined in B1. This is commonly used in scenarios where users need to associate records or values with a particular field in a form, such as selecting a business partner, item, or warehouse from a list.

editable.description: Determine whether the control is editable

multiSelection.description: Whether to allow select multiple items

filter.description: OData filter string to filter the table data

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible

valueStateText.description: An additional text show around for valueState

linkTo.description: The table name associated with the current ChooseFromList.

change.description: Fired when value changed in the input control.

b1.sdk.MultiComboBox.title: UI Control: MultiComboBox
b1.sdk.MultiComboBox.description: MultiComboBox control provides a list box with items and a text field allowing the user to either type a value directly into the control or choose from the list of existing items.

tooltip.description: Tooltip text when user hover on this control.

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible

enabled.description: determine whether the control is enabled

showSecondaryValues.description: indicates whether the text values of the additionalText property of a `b1.sdk.Item` are shown

showSelectAll.description: determines if the select all checkbox is visible on top of suggestions

valueStateText.description: An additional text show around for valueState

selectionChange.description: Fired when selection of an item is changed.

selectionFinish.description: Fired when user has finished a selection of items in a list box and list box has been closed.

loadItems.description: Fired when the end user clicks the control button to open the dropdown list and the data used to display items is not already loaded.

b1.sdk.MultiInput.title: UI Control: MultiInput
b1.sdk.MultiInput.description: MultiInput control allows the user to enter multiple values, which are displayed as tokens.

tooltip.description: Tooltip text when user hover on this control.

visible.description: Determine whether the control is visible

enabled.description: determine whether the control is enabled

editable.description: determine whether the control is editable

mandatory.description: Whether display a red asterisk before label text

maxTokens.description: the max number of tokens that is allowed in control

showValueHelp.description: a value help indicator will be displayed inside the control

showSuggestion.description: suggest event is fired when user types in the control

enableTextToken.description: determine whether the text value is converted into a token

suggestionItems.description: Items displayed in the suggestion popup(see `b1.sdk.Item`).

change.description: Fired when the text in the control field has changed and the focus leaves the control field or the enter key is pressed.

valueHelpRequest.description: Fired When the value help indicator is clicked.

tokenUpdate.description: Fired when the tokens aggregation changed due to a user interaction (add / remove token).

suggest.description: Fired when user types in the input and showSuggestion is set to true.

b1.sdk.Token.title: UI Control Aggregate: Token
b1.sdk.Token.description: Tokens are small items of information (similar to tags) that mainly serve to visualize previously selected items.
